I answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

I checked first that Tobias is a member of that channel, then read only that channel. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her 18:43 update said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

The channel doesn't give a street address for the site, and I didn't look anywhere else for one.
